title: The associated sheaf of a flat module is tensor-flat
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $M$ an $A$-module. Suppose $M$ is flat (tensoring $A$-modules with $M$ preserves exact sequences). Let $\widetilde M$ be the associated sheaf on $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections]. Then $\widetilde M$ is tensor-flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]: right tensoring with it on sheaves of structure-sheaf modules preserves finite limits and finite colimits. No finiteness or nonzero-ring hypothesis is imposed.

source.document: Stacks Project, Schemes and Sheaves of Modules
source.place: Tag 01HV (lemma-spec-sheaves), items (6)--(7); Tag 05NE (lemma-flat-stalks-flat), stalk-flat implies sheaf-flat direction; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01HV and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/05NE

proof.text: At each prime x of A, the structure-sheaf stalk is the localization A_x and the associated-sheaf stalk is the localization M_x [lem-weil-pbc-spec-tilde-stalk-localization]. In Lean the scalar-tower compatibility is reflexive on the moduleStructurePresheaf presentation. Apply Mathlib Module.Flat.of_isLocalizedModule to the germ map StructureSheaf.toStalkₗ. This proves that M_x is flat over A_x, including M = 0; when A is the zero ring there are no primes to check.

For any exact short complex C of structure-sheaf modules, its stalk complex at x is exact by [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-exact]. Tensor that complex with M_x; Mathlib Module.Flat.rTensor_shortComplex_exact preserves exactness. The natural stalk-tensor isomorphisms [lem-pc-ringed-space-module-stalk-tensor] give an isomorphism from the stalk of the sheaf-tensored complex to this exact module complex. Naturality gives both commuting squares of the short-complex isomorphism. Transport exactness back and detect it stalkwise using [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-exact]. Thus right tensoring with the associated sheaf preserves exact short complexes.

The tensor functor is additive by the monoidal-preadditive clause of [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. Apply Mathlib Functor.preservesHomology_of_map_exact, then Functor.preservesFiniteLimits_of_preservesHomology and Functor.preservesFiniteColimits_of_preservesHomology. Their conjunction is precisely SheafOfModules.IsFlat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules].
